correctness.rationale: The exact \(H^2\) norm and parity sampling bases are cited from Proposition 7.2 of arxiv:2607.17726. The frame operator is exactly (\(I-P_J+U^*P_LU\))/2, whose full spectrum is obtained by the standard finite-rank two-projection cosine-sine decomposition. Every maximal Cauchy minor is nonzero; the rational-function argument forces all principal cosines <1. The inverse block Cauchy formula is verified directly by rational interpolation and gives the rank-one \(N^{2m-1}\) leading term with singular coefficient \(S_m\). The asymptotic sharp lower constant follows from a Taylor expansion. Embedded CHECK.py verifies related finite algebra, not infinite results.

The exact criterion \(\ell\ge m\), optimal constants for every finite arrangement, and explicit size-dependent high-order \(N^{-(4m-2)}\) collapse quantify how ill-conditioned recovery becomes.
